objective: Determine which work can be scheduled across a classical eight-stage RODAS5P attempt when state forcing remains nonlinear.
claim: For pure additive f=N(t,y)+g(t), six distinct forcing clocks suffice for eight classical stages. The nonlinear state stages retain depth eight. The kernel is algebraically equivalent to a direct sum with the same evaluation/addition order and finite values.
implementation: vigilode::split_forcing::SplitForcing::{new,direct_problem,prepare_rodas5p_trial}; returns ordinary Problem. Each prepared grid is immutable; all nonmatching clocks evaluate g directly.
safeguards: immutable model while Problem lives; callbacks deterministic and side-effect-free
on-miss exact-time evaluation, including every unclipped, retry or finite-difference probe
computed failures deferred to matching request; state callback errors preserve precedence
dense analytic derivative must be partial_t N+g'; FD sees composite
NaN sentinel for every state and forcing component: invalid complete outputs produce a fatal facade-contract error, including only at consumption for a speculative forcing row

ForcingWork counts prepared + misses = actual forcing evaluations; hits include requested rows with cached errors. failed_evaluations counts actual failures once. Snapshot after parallel activity stops.
comparison: direct composite, cached serial, cached 2 and 4 local workers
public production Rodas5p::solve called from fixture
charge table preparation and full native solve; pool construction amortized
record actual final bits, 1 accepted, 0 rejected in timing cohort
fixed manufactured g, analytic independent endpoint vs SciPy BDF and Radau, three requested tolerances

next.experiment: Consume every actually proposed/limited trial grid prior to stage one under an opt-in adaptive hook. Keep current off-grid rejection-safe implementation.
next.acceptance: Analytic and FD time-derivative bits; rejections, clipping, error precedence, true callback counts including speculative work; held-out expensive physical forcing. Compare serial dedup and direct composition in paired counterbalanced runs under existing load limit, before any Auto/default consideration.

exclusions: general wall speedup or production promotion
equivalence under mutable model epoch, random or side-effecting g
adaptive refreshing beyond the user-proposed trial
